notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Jaxis.
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Thermopod with haste.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Thermopod token, adding {R}.
The Thermopod token dies, triggering itself and Jaxis.
Resolve the Thermopod token's trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Jaxis trigger, untapping it.
Repeat.
